title: Free-cumulant (planar/R-transform) spectral-edge bound for B = max_b |eta_b|: the period law's free cumulants are NOT O(1) and the low (proven) ones give only the semicircle edge 2 sqrt(n); the edge to sqrt(n log m) is carried by the high free cumulants of order r ~ log m = the open deep moments
